name: Omaclippr
author: dooooooks
description: Background instant replay buffer to capture your best gaming moments and desktop highlights on demand.

barWidget.description: Instant replay buffer with a status pill, clip trigger, and recent clip shelf.

schema.label: Default replay length
schema.description: Seconds of footage kept in the RAM ring buffer. Longer clips use proportionally more memory.

schema.label: Default quality
schema.description: Low (720p 30fps ~4 Mbps), Balanced (1080p 60fps ~9 Mbps), or High (native 60fps ~18 Mbps).
